});}

// V79: hand-scattered ground: irregular asphalt fragments, loose gravel and weeds.
// Separate visible meshes, not a repeated flat texture.
function groundDetailsSoft(){
 const zones=[[-18,15,26,15],[12,29,21,16],[37,66,20,17],[67,108,23,16],[-76,95,17,16],[17,-21,24,16]];
 for(const [cx,cz,rx,rz] of zones){
  addObject(cx,cz,Math.max(rx,rz)+3,arr=>{
   for(let j=0;j<7;j++){
    const px=cx+(random()-.5)*rx*1.65,pz=cz+(random()-.5)*rz*1.65;
    const r=1.3+random()*3.7,ry=r*(.42+random()*.8),corners=5+Math.floor(random()*3),phase=random()*6.283;
    const pts=[];
    for(let k=0;k<corners;k++){const a=phase+k*6.283/corners,rad=.67+random()*.42,xx=px+Math.cos(a)*r*rad,zz=pz+Math.sin(a)*ry*rad;pts.push([xx,height(xx,zz)+.105,zz]);}
    const mid=[px,height(px,pz)+.11,pz],col=j%3===0?[64,66,63]:[48+Math.floor(random()*19),51+Math.floor(random()*15),49+Math.floor(random()*13)];
    for(let k=0;k<corners;k++)triangle(arr,mid,pts[k],pts[(k+1)%corners],col,9);
    if(j%2===0){const a=pts[0],b=pts[2],c=pts[3];triangle(arr,[a[0],a[1]+.012,a[2]],[b[0],b[1]+.012,b[2]],[c[0],c[1]+.012,c[2]],[30,34,31],9);}
   }
   for(let j=0;j<105;j++){
    const x=cx+(random()-.5)*rx*2,z=cz+(random()-.5)*rz*2;
    const y=height(x,z)+.12,w=.05+random()*.22,h=.025+random()*.13;
    const c=j%5===0?[89,84,73]:[121,115,100];
    triangle(arr,[x-w,y,z-w],[x+w,y,z-w*.2],[x,y+h,z+w],c,8);
    if(j%4===0){const g=.18+random()*.46;triangle(arr,[x-g*.14,y,z],[x+g*.14,y,z],[x+g*.1,y+g,z+.05],[46,76,43],6);}
   }
  });
 }
}

// V82 — true-to-life metre scale: a 1.75 m person, 2.15 m doorway,
// 2.8 m ceiling and walk-in abandoned buildings with physical furniture.
function abandonedInteriorSoft(x,z,w=9,d=11){
 addObject(x,z,Math.max(w,d)*1.5,arr=>{
  const y=height(x,z)-.08,wall=[107,104,94],trim=[61,59,53],wood=[103,79,56];
  const b=(xx,yy,zz,ww,hh,dd,col,mat=4)=>box(arr,xx,yy,zz,ww,hh,dd,col,mat);
  b(x,y,z,w,.16,d,[105,102,92],8);
  for(const side of [-1,1]){
   b(x+side*(w/2-.13),y,z,.26,2.85,d,wall,8);
   for(const zz of [-d*.29,d*.25])b(x+side*(w/2-.35),y+1.08,z+zz,.15,1.1,1.15,[24,31,29],8);
  }
  b(x,y,z+d/2-.12,w,2.85,.24,wall,8);
  const open=2.1;
  b(x-(w+open)/4,y,z-d/2+.12,(w-open)/2,2.85,.24,wall,8);
  b(x+(w+open)/4,y,z-d/2+.12,(w-open)/2,2.85,.24,wall,8);
  b(x,y+2.15,z-d/2+.12,open,.70,.24,wall,8);
  // No solid roof: sunlight and camera can enter, revealing the rooms.
  b(x-w*.25,y,z+d*.12,1.75,.72,.85,wood,4);
  b(x+w*.18,y,z+d*.21,2.05,.72,1.12,trim,4);
  b(x+w*.18,y+.72,z+d*.21,2.1,.10,1.15,wood,4);
  b(x-w*.32,y,z-d*.06,1.05,1.65,.42,[65,62,57],8);
  for(let j=0;j<5;j++){
   let xx=x+(random()-.5)*(w-1.2),zz=z+(random()-.5)*(d-1.2);
   b(xx,height(xx,zz)+.04,zz,.16+random()*.35,.09+random()*.23,.15+random()*.35,[81,76,66],8);
  }
  // Human-sized silhouette to calibrate the player and architecture.
  const hx=x+w*.32,hz=z+d*.24,hy=height(hx,hz);
  b(hx,hy,hz,.48,1.02,.25,[62,66,62],7);
  b(hx,hy+1.02,hz,.28,.28,.27,[103,95,80],7);
  for(const side of [-1,1])b(hx+side*.17,hy-.75,hz,.13,.75,.17,[54,52,49],7);
 });
}

function cssResize(){const w=Math.max(300,innerWidth),h=Math.max(230,innerHeight),d=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,1.5),factor=chooseQuality===0?.68:chooseQuality===1?.88:1.08;canvas.width=Math.round(w*factor*d);canvas.height=Math.round(h*factor*d);}
cssResize();window.addEventListener('resize',cssResize);
const clamp=(n,a,b)=>Math.min(b,Math.max(a,n));
const vlen=(x,z)=>Math.hypot(x,z);
function go(x,z){if(Math.abs(x)>174||Math.abs(z)>174)return false;const h=height(x,z),current=height(player.x,player.z);if(h-current>1.9)return false;
 if(vlen(x+48,z-58)<7.7&&Math.abs(z-58)<32)return false;
 for(const h of [[-23,49,8,6],[-12,57,7,5],[-31,63,9,6.5],[-40,52,6.5,5],[60,84,8.2,6.2],[92,86,7.2,5.4],[79,109,8.4,6.2]])if(Math.abs(x-h[0])<h[2]*.5+.55&&Math.abs(z-h[1])<h[3]*.5+.55)return false;
 if(Math.abs(x-78)<11&&Math.abs(z-86)<11)return false;
 return true;}
function use(){if(lift.interact())return;const r=relics.find(r=>!r.got&&Math.hypot(r.x-player.x,r.z-player.z)<6);
 if(r){r.got=true;$('count').textContent=relics.filter(q=>q.got).length+' / 3 RELIKER';$('quest').textContent='Relik från '+r.name+' funnen!';}
 else if(relics.every(r=>r.got)&&Math.hypot(player.x-5,player.z+12)<8){$('quest').textContent='Tornet väcks! Du har klarat uppdraget.';}
 else if(Math.hypot(player.x+48,player.z-58)<36){$('quest').textContent='Det övergivna skeppets skrov är genomrostat och sönderslaget.';}
 else if(Math.hypot(player.x-78,player.z-86)<26){$('quest').textContent='Eiffeltornet reser sig ur dimman. Området runt det är tätare och mer detaljerat nu.';}
 else if(Math.hypot(player.x+18,player.z-36)<20||Math.hypot(player.x-78,player.z-86)<34){$('quest').textContent='Gräs, grus och något som rör sig i vegetationen gör platsen mer levande.';}
 else $('quest').textContent='Hitta de tre relikerna och återvänd till tornet.';}
function setPause(value){paused=value;$('pause').textContent=paused?'Fortsätt':'Pausa';}
$('start').addEventListener('click',()=>{active=true;setPause(false);$('intro').hidden=true;});
$('startShip').addEventListener('click',()=>{player.x=-10;player.z=23;player.yaw=2.3;player.pitch=0;resetY();active=true;setPause(false);$('intro').hidden=true;$('quest').textContent='Du står framför det enorma skeppsvraket. Titta omkring i 3D!';});
$('startTower').addEventListener('click',()=>{player.x=91;player.z=100.5;player.yaw=1.57;player.pitch=0;resetY();active=true;setPause(false);$('intro').hidden=true;$('quest').textContent='Eiffeltornet reser sig ur dimman framför dig. Utforska området!';});
$('pause').addEventListener('click',()=>setPause(!paused));
$('quality').addEventListener('click',()=>{chooseQuality=(chooseQuality+1)%3;$('quality').textContent='3D: '+['snabb','kompatibel','detaljerad'][chooseQuality];cssResize();});
$('light').addEventListener('click',()=>{document.body.classList.toggle('ask-day');$('light').textContent=document.body.classList.contains('ask-day')?'Ljus: dag':'Ljus: skymning';});
$('jump').addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>jumpWanted=true);
$('use').addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>useWanted=true);
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.code]=true;if(e.code==='Space')jumpWanted=true;if(e.code==='KeyE')useWanted=true;if(['Space','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight'].includes(e.code))e.preventDefault();});
window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.code]=false);
window.addEventListener('blur',()=>{for(const k in keys)keys[k]=false;stick.x=stick.y=0;});
const move=$('move');function stickChange(e){const r=move.getBoundingClientRect();stick.x=clamp((e.clientX-r.left-r.width/2)/40,-1,1);stick.y=clamp((e.clientY-r.top-r.height/2)/40,-1,1);move.querySelector('i').style.transform=`translate(${stick.x*30}px,${stick.y*30}px)`;}
move.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{pointerId=e.pointerId;move.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);stickChange(e);});
move.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(pointerId===e.pointerId)stickChange(e);});
for(const ev of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])move.addEventListener(ev,()=>{pointerId=null;stick.x=stick.y=0;move.querySelector('i').style.transform='';});
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(!active||paused)return;look={id:e.pointerId,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);});
canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!active||paused||!look||e.pointerId!==look.id)return;player.yaw-=clamp(e.clientX-look.x,-100,100)*.005;player.pitch=clamp(player.pitch-clamp(e.clientY-look.y,-100,100)*.004,-1.1,1.1);look.x=e.clientX;look.y=e.clientY;});
for(const ev of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])canvas.addEventListener(ev,()=>look=null);
function update(dt){if(!active||paused){lift.update(0,active,paused);jumpWanted=useWanted=false;return;}if(lift.aboard){if(useWanted)lift.interact();useWanted=false;lift.update(dt,active,paused);return;}let sx=(keys.KeyD?1:0)-(keys.KeyA?1:0)+stick.x,fw=(keys.KeyW||keys.ArrowUp?1:0)-(keys.KeyS||keys.ArrowDown?1:0)-stick.y;
player.yaw+=((keys.ArrowLeft?1:0)-(keys.ArrowRight?1:0))*dt*1.9;
let pads=[];try{pads=Array.from(navigator.getGamepads?.()||[])}catch{}const pad=pads.find(p=>p?.connected);if(pad){sx+=(pad.axes[0]||0);fw-=(pad.axes[1]||0);player.yaw-=(pad.axes[2]||0)*dt*2;player.pitch=clamp(player.pitch-(pad.axes[3]||0)*dt*1.5,-1.1,1.1);if(pad.buttons[0]?.pressed)jumpWanted=true;if(pad.buttons[2]?.pressed)useWanted=true;}

if(vMat>10.5&&vMat<11.5){base=texture2D(uSpruceBark,vUv).rgb;rough=.98;}
else if(vMat>11.5&&vMat<12.5){if(uSpruceReady<.5)discard;vec4 needle=texture2D(uSpruceNeedles,vUv);if(needle.a<.27)discard;base=needle.rgb;rough=1.;n=gl_FrontFacing?n:-n;}

}
else if(vMat>2.5&&vMat<3.5){vec3 metal=atlas(4.,uv);float rust=grain(vP.zy*.062)*.36+grain(vP.xy*.12)*.34+g*.30;base=mix(metal,vec3(.25,.11,.065),smoothstep(.53,.74,rust)*.28);base*=mix(.73,1.18,clamp(dot(vC,vec3(.333)),0.,1.));rough=.67;wet=.12;}
